UTILITY_FAIL.title: AC Utility Power Failure
UTILITY_FAIL.description: Mains utility grid electricity lost. Inverter has automatically transferred to battery backup mode.

UTILITY_RESTORE.title: AC Utility Power Restored
UTILITY_RESTORE.description: Grid electricity returned to nominal range. UPS transferred back to normal line mode and resumed battery charging.

BATTERY_LOW.title: Low Battery Warning
BATTERY_LOW.description: Battery reserve capacity is critically low. Connected computers and devices should be shut down safely immediately.

BATTERY_NORMAL.title: Battery Reserve Normal
BATTERY_NORMAL.description: Battery voltage recovered above the critical low-voltage cutoff threshold.

OVERLOAD.title: UPS Output Overload Alarm
OVERLOAD.description: Connected power consumption exceeds 100% rated capacity. Disconnect non-critical loads to prevent immediate shutdown.

OVERLOAD_CLEARED.title: Output Load Normalized
OVERLOAD_CLEARED.description: Operating power demand returned within rated capacity boundaries.

OVER_TEMP.title: High Heatsink Temperature Warning
OVER_TEMP.description: Internal inverter heatsink reached thermal warning limits. Verify cooling fan operation and ventilation airflow.

TEMP_NORMAL.title: Operating Temperature Normal
TEMP_NORMAL.description: Internal unit temperatures returned to standard operating limits.

BYPASS_ACTIVE.title: Static Bypass Active
BYPASS_ACTIVE.description: Load is running directly off unconditioned utility bypass line. Inverter protection is bypassed.

BYPASS_CLEARED.title: Conditioned Inverter Restored
BYPASS_CLEARED.description: Output safely transferred from static bypass back to conditioned PWM inverter power.

UPS_FAULT.title: UPS Hardware Fault Alarm
UPS_FAULT.description: Internal hardware failure or power bus abnormality detected by inverter processor.

CONNECT.title: UPS Communication Established
CONNECT.description: Hardware communication link established with local controller.

DISCONNECT.title: UPS Communication Disconnected
DISCONNECT.description: Communication link to the UPS port closed or disconnected.

CONNECT_ERROR.title: UPS Connection Failure
CONNECT_ERROR.description: Failed to open serial or USB HID transport to the designated port.

POLL_ERROR.title: Telemetry Polling Error
POLL_ERROR.description: Hardware telemetry query timed out or returned corrupted response packet.

APP_START.title: UPSED Application Started
APP_START.description: UPSED background monitor and system services started.

APP_HIDE.title: UPSED Window Hidden
APP_HIDE.description: Application window minimized or hidden to system tray.

a0.title: Battery Disconnected
a0.description: Battery circuit breaker is open or battery terminals are disconnected. Check battery cabling.

a1.title: Neutral Line Disconnected
a1.description: Neutral wire is not detected at input terminals. Check AC wiring polarity.

a2.title: Site Wiring Fault
a2.description: Ground wire or neutral line reverse phase detected at building outlet.

a3.title: Phase Sequence Incorrect
a3.description: Input AC supply three-phase rotation direction is reversed.

a4.title: Bypass Phase Sequence Incorrect
a4.description: Bypass line input phase rotation does not match primary input.

a5.title: Input Frequency Unstable in Bypass
a5.description: Grid frequency fluctuation exceeds synchronized tracking limits.

a6.title: Battery Overcharged
a6.description: Battery float voltage exceeds permissible high threshold. Charger halted.

a7.title: Low Battery
a7.description: Battery energy level low. Operating time is limited.

a8.title: Output Overload
a8.description: Total appliance power draw exceeds continuous rating of inverter.

a9.title: Cooling Fan Alarm
a9.description: Cooling fan speed is abnormal or fan is locked by foreign object.

a10.title: Emergency Power Off (EPO) Activated
a10.description: Hardware emergency power cut switch engaged. Inverter output disabled.

a11.title: Abnormal Power Turn On
a11.description: Inverter power-up sequence failed to establish stable bus voltage.

a12.title: Over Temperature Alarm
a12.description: Thermal sensors report dangerous heatsink or ambient temperatures.

a13.title: Battery Charger Alarm
a13.description: Internal charging circuit malfunctioned. Batteries cannot recharge.

a14.title: Remote Auto Shutdown Initiated
a14.description: Remote command or automated shutdown countdown triggered on UPS.

a55.title: Battery Replacement Required
a55.description: Battery internal resistance test failed. Battery pack aged and needs replacement.

a60.title: Bypass Unstable
a60.description: Static bypass line AC voltage or frequency outside safe bypass transfer window.

a69.title: Battery Self-Test Failed
a69.description: 10-second battery discharge test failed to sustain load voltage.
